quote: got a Void Crystal out of it today when disenchanting it.
notes: Firsthand player statement of one completed disenchant yielding a single Void Crystal; author is the original commenter, not a copied study. Historical client/patch, skill, item level, variant and other output context not recorded. This is a single positively observed operation, not a current-Retail yield rate or a representative study. Another commenter separately claims disenchant eligibility as of patch 2.0.7; Patch 2.1.0 notes also list item. Output zero outcomes beyond this one cast are unknown; no refunds or nominal batch equivalents involved.
